name: B10-0066/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking the Iranian government to cancel the death sentences of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi and free them. It also asks Iran to stop executions, release detained European and dual nationals, and let United Nations experts in. It asks the European Union and its member states to raise these cases in talks with Iran, to sanction those responsible, and to help Iranians who need to leave.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Iran's government, detained activists and European nationals, and European Union member states.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends its demands to European Union bodies, member states and Iran.
